current_bottleneck: The deterministic retrieval-and-replay Stage A line is now treated as capped. 277d, 287e, and 288a show a stable structural tradeoff: sharp replay preserves change law but loses local level fidelity and active-cell support; soft replay improves level-side support but destroys the sharp deterministic dynamics. The active bottleneck is therefore the retrieval mechanism itself, not another local key/support tweak.
last_result_summary: Iteration 118 performed a true Stage A paradigm shift. The hierarchical 8+3 decomposition is retained, but the retrieval-based deterministic backbone is retired as the active search line. The new Stage A family is 289a-v0: a deterministic causal world-model backbone in normalized-change space, implemented as a learned parametric sequence model rather than a retrieval-and-replay system.
next_step_recommendation: Implement 289a-v0 as a deterministic causal Transformer backbone in normalized-change space, with autoregressive generated-state rollout and no retrieval bank, no low-rank head, and no bounded side paths.
